content: Pharmacophore complete, but LogP is still 5.07 and QED 0.782 because of the trifluoromethyl at atoms 19-22, which sits ortho to the anilide and does nothing but add lipophilicity and mass. Atom 18 is the aromatic carbon carrying it over a non-ring bond, so I remove the whole group. That leaves N-{4-[(4-cyclopropylpyridin-2-yl)amino]phenyl}cyclopropanecarboxamide at about 293 Da with a clean para-disubstituted central ring, LogP near 3.3 and TPSA 54 - identical to my best molecule except the pyridine 4-substituent is a cyclopropyl instead of a methyl.
